text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Today's sunbathing is~♪
In a special secret spot~♪"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: A kitty!? It's sleeping... looks so cozy...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... First come, first served, I guess...
Looks like I'll just have to find somewhere else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Rhein Kraft ended up exhausted from walking around looking for a good spot to sunbathe.
